summary: A plant closing or mass layoff has to be announced ahead of time under the WARN Act.
realLife: The Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act helps ensure advance notice in cases of qualified plant closings and mass layoffs.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, WARN Act Compliance Assistance: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/layoffs/warn
inGame: the jobs module's change rows (layoff, closure), read by the loading story's past (loading-steps.past).

turns.what: A closing comes with no notice and workers learn on the day.
turns.pulledBy: an employer's failure to meet the notice rule
turns.writesBack: a layoff row dated the same day as the closing

turns.what: A layoff is below the size that needs notice.
turns.writesBack: a layoff row with no notice period
